name: concentric-frame
title: Concentric Frame
description: A layout frame for React and shadcn that keeps nested corner radii concentric through CSS variables.

meta.details: A layout primitive that exposes outer, padding and inner radius as CSS variables so nested corners stay concentric.

docs: Import Frame, FrameInner and useFrame from components/eased/concentric-frame/concentric-frame. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
